Title: Admins may see delayed Microsoft 365 Copilot usage and Copilot Chat usage data in the Microsoft 365 admin center

User impact: Admins may see delayed Copilot usage and Copilot Chat usage data in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

More info: The affected reports currently display complete usage data through October 18th, 2026. Usage data from October 19th, 2026, onward is delayed and will become available automatically as reporting updates complete. 

Current status: Our monitoring systems have identified an issue in which admins may see delayed Microsoft 365 Copilot usage and Copilot Chat usage data in the Microsoft 365 admin center. We've identified that a compatibility issue in the upstream data processing pipeline supporting Microsoft 365 Copilot usage reporting resulted in impact. To remediate this, we've developed and deployed a code fix to all the affected environments and are monitoring the service to confirm successful remediation.

Scope of impact: Impact may occur for any admin attempting to view Copilot usage and Copilot Chat usage reports in the Microsoft 365 admin center. 

Start time: Wednesday, October 21, 2026, at 12:00 AM UTC

Root cause: A compatibility issue in the upstream data processing pipeline supporting Microsoft 365 Copilot usage reporting resulted in impact.

Next update by: Thursday, October 22, 2026, at 2:00 AM UTC
